C1211.title: Amir Hossein Golshan Sentenced to 8 Years for SIM Swapping Fraud
C1211.summary: In November 2023, the U.S. Department of Justice reported that 25-year-old Amir Hossein Golshan was sentenced by a federal court in California to eight years in prison for SIM swapping, account takeover, and other fraud schemes, and was ordered to pay about $1.2 million in restitution. Case materials also described Apple Support impersonation and social-media account hijacking affecting more than 500 victims.
